I implemented all six functions in `minidb/expr_eval.py` as specified, and `tests/test_expr_eval.py` passes (25 tests). I didn't need to edit the test file.

I didn't run the rest of the test suite. The other tests depend on modules assigned to other engineers.

I added one private helper, `_check_bool`, which raises `TypeMismatchError` for any operand that isn't a bool or NULL. `logical_not`, `logical_and`, `logical_or` and `where_matches` all use it.

`compare` also raises `TypeMismatchError` for an operator outside the six comparison operators. The stub didn't specify that case, so say if you'd rather it raise something else.
